description: List the account's codes, newest first, with each one's id, name, folder, kind (changeable or static), what it holds or where it points, short link, status and all-time scans. Use it to find a code's id before get_code, update_code or download_code; use get_code for one code's scan stats and history. Filters combine: search matches part of the name, link ending or web address (not case sensitive); folder and status must match exactly. Returns up to limit codes from offset, and total; when there are more, call again with offset set to next_offset. No matches gives an empty list. Read only; works with any key.

folder.description: Only codes in this folder (exact name; get_account lists them)

limit.description: How many codes to return, 1 to 100. Default 50

offset.description: How many matching codes to skip: next_offset from the last reply. Default 0

search.description: Part of a code's name, link ending or web address; not case sensitive

status.description: Only active codes, paused ones (they show a "paused" page when scanned), or blocked ones (switched off for breaking the rules)

name: list_codes

folder.description: Left out when the code isn't in a folder

holds.description: Where it points, or what it holds, in a few words

id.description: Use it as "code" in get_code, update_code and download_code

last_scan_at.description: ISO time of the latest scan

link.description: Changeable codes: the short link the printed code holds

locked.description: true when a lapsed plan locks editing; the code still works

scans.description: Changeable codes: scans of all time, automated checks left out

next_offset.description: Present when more codes match: pass it as offset

total.description: How many codes match, across all pages

title: List codes
